items.html: Behold, there is no Partzuf of all the five Partzufim in all the four worlds of ABYA, in which each and every one does not have three vessels for each and every one of its Sefirot, and they are three vessels for the three aspects of NRN (Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama). For up to the Neshama, which is from Bina, from which comes the aspect of the letters, there are vessels. But from there and upward, which is opposite Chaya and Yechida in each and every Sefira, there are no more vessels, for there are there the cantillation marks (Ta'amim) and the vowel points (Nekudot), and not letters. And it is known that all the vessels were made from the letters.
